PLAN "Upper Body Strength, Cardio, Mobility & Body Recomposition for Climber with Shoulder Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper body strength in pain-free range"
  GOAL secondary body_recomposition:
    name "Body recomposition: fat loss, muscle gain"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Cardiovascular endurance for long climbing days"
  GOAL secondary climbing_specific:
    name "Climbing-specific grip and movement prep"
  GOAL secondary mobility:
    name "Upper body and shoulder mobility"

SUMMARY
  duration: 12 weeks
  frequency: 4 sessions per week (Mon/Thu: upper body strength + mobility, Wed: cardio + mobility, Sat: full body finisher + mobility)
  structure:
    - Phase 1 (Weeks 1-4): Foundation — moderate intensity, focus on pain-free upper body strength, aerobic base, mobility, and full body finishers.
    - Phase 2 (Weeks 5-8): Progression — increased intensity and volume, continued mobility, longer cardio, and more challenging finishers.
    - Phase 3 (Weeks 9-12): Climbing Prep & Peak — high intensity, peaking strength, climbing-specific hangboard and core, longer endurance, and full body finishers with a taper in week 12.
  key_elements:
    - All upper body work respects pain-free range and avoids overhead loading.
    - Mobility work included in every session, with special focus on shoulders, spine, and hips.
    - Cardio 2x/week (cycling, walking) to build endurance for long climbing days.
    - Saturday "Full Body Finisher" sessions: fun, varied, full-body circuits for general fitness and enjoyment.
    - Climbing-specific prep (hangboard, plank) added in Phase 3.
    - Nutrition plan for body recomposition: mild calorie deficit, high protein, balanced macros, hydration, and periworkout nutrition.
  progression:
    - Intensity and volume increase across phases, peaking in weeks 11-12 for climbing trip.
    - Cardio duration and intensity increase gradually.
    - Mobility and stretching are consistent throughout.
    - Taper in week 12 for peak performance and recovery.
  safety:
    - No overhead or provocative shoulder loading.
    - All exercises modifiable for pain-free range.
    - Mobility and stretching to support shoulder health and climbing function.

NUTRITION
  STRATEGY body_recomposition:
    calories target "mild deficit (approx. 250-350 kcal below maintenance)"
    protein target "1.6-2.2g per kg bodyweight per day"
    carbs target "moderate, focus on whole grains, fruits, vegetables"
    fats target "balance, prioritize unsaturated fats"
    meal_frequency "3-4 meals per day, each with protein"
    periworkout "protein-rich meal or shake within 2h post-training"
    hydration "at least 2L water daily"
    notes "Track progress and adjust calories if weight loss exceeds 0.5kg/week or stalls for 2+ weeks. Prioritize nutrient-dense foods. Limit processed foods and added sugars."

PLAN "Upper Body Strength, Cardio, Mobility & Body Recomposition for Climber with Shoulder Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper body strength in pain-free range"
  GOAL secondary body_recomposition:
    name "Body recomposition: fat loss, muscle gain"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Cardiovascular endurance for long climbing days"
  GOAL secondary climbing_specific:
    name "Climbing-specific grip and movement prep"
  GOAL secondary mobility:
    name "Upper body and shoulder mobility"

SUMMARY
  duration: 12 weeks
  frequency: 4 sessions per week (Mon/Thu: upper body strength + mobility, Wed: cardio + mobility, Sat: full body finisher + mobility)
  structure:
    - Phase 1 (Weeks 1-4): Foundation — moderate intensity, focus on pain-free upper body strength, aerobic base, mobility, and full body finishers.
    - Phase 2 (Weeks 5-8): Progression — increased intensity and volume, continued mobility, longer cardio, and more challenging finishers.
    - Phase 3 (Weeks 9-12): Climbing Prep & Peak — high intensity, peaking strength, climbing-specific hangboard and core, longer endurance, and full body finishers with a taper in week 12.
  key_elements:
    - All upper body work respects pain-free range and avoids overhead loading.
    - Mobility work included in every session, with special focus on shoulders, spine, and hips.
    - Cardio 2x/week (cycling, walking) to build endurance for long climbing days.
    - Saturday "Full Body Finisher" sessions: fun, varied, full-body circuits for general fitness and enjoyment.
    - Climbing-specific prep (hangboard, plank) added in Phase 3.
    - Nutrition plan for body recomposition: mild calorie deficit, high protein, balanced macros, hydration, and periworkout nutrition.
  progression:
    - Intensity and volume increase across phases, peaking in weeks 11-12 for climbing trip.
    - Cardio duration and intensity increase gradually.
    - Mobility and stretching are consistent throughout.
    - Taper in week 12 for peak performance and recovery.
  safety:
    - No overhead or provocative shoulder loading.
    - All exercises modifiable for pain-free range.
    - Mobility and stretching to support shoulder health and climbing function.

NUTRITION
  STRATEGY body_recomposition:
    calories target "mild deficit (approx. 250-350 kcal below maintenance)"
    protein target "1.6-2.2g per kg bodyweight per day"
    carbs target "moderate, focus on whole grains, fruits, vegetables"
    fats target "balance, prioritize unsaturated fats"
    meal_frequency "3-4 meals per day, each with protein"
    periworkout "protein-rich meal or shake within 2h post-training"
    hydration "at least 2L water daily"
    notes "Track progress and adjust calories if weight loss exceeds 0.5kg/week or stalls for 2+ weeks. Prioritize nutrient-dense foods. Limit processed foods and added sugars."
